roads.name: Trans Canada Highway
words: Sweeping and steady: 11 curves in 2.7 miles.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From -2 to 67 ft, with 152 ft of up and down along the way.
23 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 70 km/h limit its corners still ask for about 0.58 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
